integrity: The exact heavy-tail coefficient is proved analytically; finite numerical trials are diagnostics only. Publication precedence beyond inspected literature remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Fixed m and deterministic evaluation location; one uniform sample per complete equal-width cell; exact arithmetic Lagrange interpolation; noise is independent, centered, homoscedastic with finite nonzero variance. Does not cover safeguarded interpolation, floating-point evaluation, adaptive node locations, or higher-dimensional designs.
title: Exact collision-tail law for one-per-cell random Lagrange interpolation
